verified.material_note: Raw-trace ablation verified; TerminalBench is benchmark-specialized, not held-out generalization.
Seven matched DesignHarness gains and hidden dev gate verified; no direct single-vs-multi-component ablation.
Strict-gate ablation and negative-transfer evidence verified; validation safety is not a universal unseen-distribution guarantee.
Current named author-page numbers verify worker values; stale/anonymous public mirror exposes incompatible values and must not be mixed.

Table 4 transfer matrix and disjoint held-out protocol verified. Evaluation tasks are selected from the seed-0 intersection of failures of both recipients; gains therefore support the frozen bundle+task-conditioned-adapter protocol on this hard selected set, not full-distribution effect sizes or component isolation. GPT donor is stronger or tied, not strictly higher in every cell.
Selective beats full-bank, but selective vs always-inject is aggregation-dependent: macro favors selective 64.3 vs 63.5, micro favors always-inject 61.5 vs 61.2.
Table 2/3 numbers verified; w/o-Subgoal removes subgoal decomposition and context folding together, so folding is not causally isolated.
Inherited drift, 16/32-step recovery pattern, goal-recognition/action gap, and environment dependence verified; mitigation proposals remain extrapolated.

206-VLM/31-benchmark setup, Pocock sequential method, 15/30/50% CI targets, >2pp >=60% savings, 55% vs 76% pair resolution and 63% deployment case verified. ±3/±2/±1.5 values are 95% CI half-width targets; many-model multiple-hypothesis correction is explicitly simplified.

AgentSuite Filtering explicitly re-scores the same Original trajectories with no reruns. tau-bench, CFBench, ACEBench and overall rank reversals are verified from committed CSVs. Filtering drops FIX/TODO as well as REMOVE, so the evidence is audit-flagged task-composition sensitivity, not proof every dropped task is invalid; Fixed behavior is separate and not live on the current leaderboard.

9 judges on 1,000 MNLI items give Kish n_eff=2.18 [2.07,2.31], mean phi=.391, panel 72.0% vs best single 71.8%; RewardBench n_eff=1.99 [1.83,2.20], panel 92.7% vs best single 95.5%. CoT increases correlation in this tested setup and one-per-family n_eff is 1.93. Do not treat n_eff≈2 as universal or directly transfer classification/preference results to open-ended O evaluation without measurement.

High critic metrics are verified alongside harmful intervention outcomes: HotPotQA best deltas -2.3/0.0/-25.5pp and GAIA -4.4/-4.4/-30.0pp across Qwen/GLM/MiniMax; ALFWorld full-table best deltas +2.8/+1.1/+0.5pp. ALFWorld critic weights are zero-shot transfer, but temperature scaling uses ALFWorld validation. Keep the 50-task pilot p/r/d and +4.7pp ROLLBACK result separate from the full 202-task Table-4 best +2.8pp uncalibrated APPEND result.

WSC 2004 correlated-sampling OCBA verified. At T=500 in CRN U/U/1, PCS EBA/CBA/IBA/seqCBA=.857/.943/.935/.977; EBA needs 1020 to match CBA PCS and 1680 to match seqCBA. In the paper's two-design Gaussian result, sufficiently high positive correlation relative to variance imbalance makes equal allocation optimal; do not transfer a monotone 'more correlation => more skew' rule or universal 2-3x speedup to agent evaluation.

Theorem 2 verifies e-BY FCR<=delta for arbitrary selection/dependence only when each marginal input is already a valid e-CI. Twitter replay: 263 experiments, K=30; at delta=.1 e-BY ships 127 vs BY 122, and on the BY-shippable common subset averages 1.2 vs 1.5 days. The Twitter marginal CS is asymptotic, so those application figures are not a standalone exact finite-sample certificate.

PACE primary arXiv abstract verifies paired anytime-valid per-candidate acceptance on Qwen2.5 prompt evolution: greedy commits 30-42% false and 10-33% harmful edits when one true gain is hidden among noise; with no real gain it commits 13-21 spurious edits/run with 72-100% false and up to 4.9-point degradation; PACE holds baseline and reports ~18% lower evaluation cost. The abstract explicitly says the guarantee is per-decision, not lineage-level. Detailed theorem/table internals remain pending full-text primary access.

arXiv:2607.19592v1 full HTML defines the three-stage task-level forum -> cross-task forum -> distillation protocol, but has no explicit ablation section or matched remove-one-stage performance table. Table 5 stance counts and worked examples are process/mechanism evidence, not outcome ablations. Held-out transfer always uses a task-conditioned adapter and has no no-adapter/fixed-selection control. Whole-protocol curated-knowledge persistence is supported; separate causal contributions of forum stages, distillation, and adapter remain unidentified rather than negatively refuted.
